plan.title: Heart and Eyes Graphic Cotton T-Shirt, Unisex Short Sleeve Crew Neck
plan.intro:
Cotton crew-neck T-shirt with heart-and-eyes graphics and short sleeves. Sizes XXS–3XL; check the selected color/design in the product images.

FIT: Compare the listed garment bust, length, shoulder and sleeve measurements with a well-fitting T-shirt before selecting a size. The bust value is the full garment circumference, not the flat width. Check the size and color combination before ordering. Measurements are in cm; allow the stated 2–3 cm manual measurement difference.
